answer: Give every agent identity a reputation ledger that starts empty and can only be filled by verifiable work: completed tasks, attestations from long-established peers, resolved disputes. New identities are voiceless — one among an ocean of unproven claimants — until their ledger shows a real trail. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand identities cheaply, but cannot mint a thousand histories: each fake needs months of genuine service to earn an opal of trust. The signal the network reads is proven past behavior, and counterfeiting behavior at scale is the one cost a sybil factory cannot fake away.
